SELECT COUNT(*) FROM homework
AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

SELECT h.homeworkid, h.title, h.content, h.courseid, h.teacherid, h.type, h.deadline, h.createtime, h.attachment, c.coursename, c.semester, t.teachername FROM homework h LEFT JOIN course c ON h.courseid = c.courseid LEFT JOIN teacher t ON h.teacherid = t.teacherid WHERE h.homeworkid = #{homeworkid}

SELECT h.homeworkid, h.title, h.content, h.courseid, h.teacherid, h.type, h.deadline, h.createtime, h.attachment, c.coursename, c.semester, t.teachername FROM homework h LEFT JOIN course c ON h.courseid = c.courseid LEFT JOIN teacher t ON h.teacherid = t.teacherid WHERE h.courseid = #{courseid} ORDER BY h.createtime DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO homework (title, content, courseid, teacherid, type, deadline, createtime, attachment) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{courseid}, #{teacherid}, #{type}, #{deadline}, #{createtime}, #{attachment})
